name: Farinasea
source:
The youngest child of the family which has always served under the reigning monarch as its most trusted adviser, she is the current head of her clan and has declared neutrality in the ongoing Succession War. She struck up a friendship with Fabio when they were younger and still treats him as a long-lost first love.

[Spoiler] Her parents chose her to be the next head of the family and raised her to be worthy of the position from a young age. In addition to the pressure of expectation, her older siblings resented her new status and subjected her to incessant bullying. As a result she had a lonely and stressful childhood and cried often when alone. When she was moved to a country house on the orders of her mother to recuperate, she met Fabio by accident and shared many happy memories playing with him. Although she was eventually separated from him, her memory of their shared experiences helped her overcome the pressure and bullying, eventually assuming her position as head of the clan and sending her older siblings off on political marriages to remote corners of the kingdom.

The halberd she wields amplifies her natural affinity to control lightning and serves as the artefact which cements her status as a Great Noble. 

She has a slightly warped personality as a result of her upbringing and undying infatuation for Fabio. Possesses an enormous collection of romance novels (with a few penned by herself) in her castle, which she is too embarrassed to mention to Primtine when she starts the castle consuming process. She also has unshakeable faith in absolute violence in the name of "corrective discipline" against her bullying siblings who tried her patience too far...

She will only join Primtine's faction as a companion in her route. In her ending, she serves as Fabio's bodyguard (together with Ardbelt) when he tours the realm on official duty. In her true end, she bears Fabio's child who inherits both her lightning abilities and Fabio's incubus traits. [/Spoiler]
